role: Geometry-based spatial relationship extractor between confirmed tracked objects in image space.
detail: Computes six spatial predicates (left_of, right_of, above, below, near, on_top_of) from normalized bounding box geometry of TrackedObject instances. SpatialRelationshipExtractor is the main public class; it filters to CONFIRMED tracks only, processes all ordered pairs, and emits SpatialRelation dataclasses with confidence scores. Confidence formulas are geometric: directional predicates scale linearly from 0 at position_margin to 1.0 at 3x margin; near confidence is 1.0 - (dist / near_threshold); on_top_of combines positional overlap and area-ratio terms. All coordinates are normalized to [0.0, 1.0] by dividing pixel values by frame dimensions. No depth estimation or world-space coordinates are produced (per CANON A.13, ultrasonic deferred to Phase 2). Side effects: none (pure computation, returns SpatialRelation list).
gotchas: No depth signal from monocular camera; bounding-box area is only rough size proxy. Degenerate bboxes (zero area or height) are guarded against in on_top_of computation. TENTATIVE/LOST/DELETED tracks silently filtered before pair processing. Confidence clamped to [0.0, 1.0] to handle edge cases.
